Independent implementation enumerated all 65536 successor choices, obtained 2048 distinct rooted words and exactly 384 possible seven-site sets, then computed a7 for every word: min216 (4 words), max368 (2), total589120, 120 distinct values.
All 30 short factor coverage masks and 2048*384 membership decisions evaluated; these are full finite exhaustions, not samples.
correctness.rationale: All 32 length-five factors occur once, so at least ceil(32/5)=7 marks. Any seven marks hitting all length-five windows have positive gaps <=5 with deficits summing to three; 84 ordered deficit vectors yield exactly 384 distinct indexed candidate sets. Such a candidate hits all longer factors by the uniquely occurring length-five prefix; 30 short factor masks decide remaining lengths one through four. Exhaustively enumerate 2^16 shift-compatible state successor choices, the 2048 cycles with a single 32-cycle, and all 384 candidates. An independent Euler-tour enumeration supplies a second proof of completeness.
residual_risks: Finite independent checks verify stated finite claims only; all-parameter conclusions depend on reconstructed mathematical arguments.
